title: Higher order H{ö}lder approximation by solutions of second order elliptic equations
summary: For a given second order elliptic operation $\mathcal{L}$ in a domain $Ω\subset{\mathbb{R}}^\mathbf{N}$, $\mathbf{N}\ $, and a compact set $\mathbf{K}\subsetΩ$, order $\mathbf{N}$-$2$-Ahlfors-David regular, we define the space $\mathcal{H}^{\mathbf{r}+ω}_{\mathcal{L}}(\mathbf{K})$ of continuous functions $f(x),\, x\in\mathbf{K}$, admitting, for any $δ>0$, a local approximation in the $δ$-neighborhood of any point $x\in\mathbf{K}$, with $δ^{\mathbf{r}}ω(δ)$-error estimate, by solutions of the equation $\mathcal{L} u=0$. For such functions, we prove the existence of a global approximation…
